subject: [NAME] - Vision AI
text:
Hi [NAME],

Just watched the SOLV demo - pretty cool staff you are building on edge.
Very similar to [COMPANY], many AgriTech/Drone companies we work with
are building vision models for farming use cases.

Teams like Carbon Robotics & Aigen (farming automation on the ground) and
Zeitview & Buzz (aerial inspection) came to us when the sheer volume of
video/sensor data became too much for internal/open source tools to handle.
We help them automate annotation at scale with model-assisted labeling,
HITL review, workflow automation, and model evaluation.

Quick context: Encord is a data development platform for computer vision
and multimodal AI (image, video, 3d point cloud). We just released the
world's largest multimodal AI dataset yesterday! We're venture backed, $50M
raised Series B, and supporting 200+ AI teams to date.

Curious if you're seeing similar data bottlenecks at [COMPANY]. Let me
know if you are open to a quick chat next Tue to Thu mornings PT.

text:

in-house vision models.
